articles.headline: Bradley passes 200 strikeouts, pitches Twins to 3-2 win over Giants
articles.body:
SAN FRANCISCO -- — 


              Minnesota’s Taj Bradley held the Giants to a run on three hits in six innings and the Twins knocked off San Francisco 3-2 on Tuesday night.


              Bradley (12-6) struck out Drew Gilbert leading off the first for his 200th strikeout of the season. He became the ninth pitcher in the majors to reach the 200-strikeout plateau in 2026 and finished Tuesday’s game with six K’s, giving him 205 for the year.


              His previous career high was 154, set with Tampa Bay in 2024.


              San Francisco scored a run in the ninth and had men at first and second with two outs before Jeff Hoffman struck out Victor Bericoto swinging on a 3-2 slider to earn his sixth save.


              Giants starter Anthony Molina (3-2) retired the first 10 Minnesota hitters before Brooks Lee singled with one out in the fourth inning. Molina carried a 1-0 lead into the sixth.


              Then with one out, Ryan Kreidler singled, and Luke Keaschall hit a triple to the left-center gap that made it a 1-1 game. Lee followed with a single to right to drive in Keaschall and put the Twins on top.


              Molina allowed those two runs on four hits in six innings. He struck out six and walked one.


              Walker Jenkins jolted the first pitch from reliever Duncan Davitt over the wall in right to lead off the seventh. Jenkins’ fourth homer of the season increased Minnesota’s edge to 3-1.


              The Giants scored their first run in the second on a safety-squeeze bunt by Drew Cavanaugh that brought home Shay Whitcomb.


              Up next
              Twins LHP Connor Prielipp (6-7, 4.94) closes the three-game series against Giants LHP Cesar Perdomo (0-1, 3.72 ERA) on Wednesday afternoon.


              ------

articles.headline: Rockies hit latest low, become fifth team with 4 straight 100-loss seasons
articles.description: The Rockies became just the fifth club in MLB history to lose at least 100 games in four straight seasons and the first to do so since th Mets from 1962 through 1965.
articles.headlineJa: ロッキーズがさらなる泥沼へ、4年連続100敗を喫した史上5番目のチームに
articles.descriptionJa: ロッキーズは、4年連続で100敗以上を喫したMLB史上わずか5番目の球団となり、これは1962年から1965年のメッツ以来の記録となった。
articles.body:
DENVER -- During a mound visit in the top of the first inning with the Colorado Rockies already trailing the Arizona Diamondbacks by two runs, a lone voice of encouragement emerged from an otherwise restless and murmuring crowd at Coors Field.

"Let's go, Rockies!" a fan shouted Tuesday from section 130, just behind home plate in the lower bowl.

It was one of the few cheers the Rockies would receive on a night they reached an ignominious historical mark.

Behind three hits from former Rockies All-Star Nolan Arenado and seven innings of two-hit ball from Michael Soroka, the Diamondbacks beat the Rockies 7-2 to guarantee Colorado its fourth straight season with at least 100 losses in front of an announced crowd of 19,324 (along with an estimated 800 dogs on one of Rockies' Bark at the Park nights).

The Rockies became just the fifth club in major league history to lose at least 100 games in four consecutive seasons and the first to do so since the New York Mets in their expansion season of 1962 through 1965.

"You learn your hardest lessons in difficulty in life," said Warren Schaeffer. who is in his first season as Colorado's full-time manager. "This is not easy. Last year, we talked about it at the end of the year, how we want to feel this and never feel it again and remember it and hold on to it. The guys have done that. We've just lost 100 again. There are a ton of lessons to learn from it. If we don't learn these lessons from these games this year, we won't get better."

It's the latest low for a franchise that has made the playoffs just twice since 2010 and hasn't won a playoff series since a memorable run to the World Series in 2007. Since the start of the 2023 season, the Rockies are a major league-worst 220-423, 23 games worse than the next-closest team, the Chicago White Sox.

"I've been a part of those here when I was here," Arenado said. "With the young group that they have, sometimes, this is just a part of it. You're going to go through some tough times. But I think from their offense and some of their bullpen guys, they've got some real arms and they've got some really good hitters. As they continue to grow, I think that's going to change."

For much of the season, it looked as though Colorado would avoid 100 losses. On Aug. 16, the Rockies beat the San Francisco Giants 13-7 for their fourth win in five games, improving to 50-74. Since then, however, Colorado has gone 7-26, including 2-13 in its past 15 games.

Some of their struggles remain familiar.

As it has for much of its history, an organization tasked with playing baseball a mile above sea level has struggled keeping opponents off the board. Entering Tuesday, the Rockies had a team ERA of 5.57, the highest mark in the majors. Colorado has finished with the highest team ERA every season since 2022 and if it does so again this year, it will become only the third club since 1913 to have the worst ERA in the majors in five consecutive seasons.

articles.headline: Miami Marlins stymie Chicago's push for NL wild card with 8-2 victory over the Cubs
articles.description: — Griffin Conine drove in Esteury Ruiz with a tiebreaking single in Miami's six-run 12th inning, and the Marlins stymied Chicago's push for an NL wild card with an 8-2 victory over the Cubs on Tuesday night.
articles.headlineJa: マイアミ・マーリンズがカブスに8-2で勝利、シカゴのナ・リーグワイルドカード争いを阻む
articles.descriptionJa: 火曜夜の試合で、マーリンズが6点を奪った延長12回にグリフィン・コニーンが勝ち越しタイムリーを放ちエステウリー・ルイーズが生還。8-2でカブスを下し、シカゴのナ・リーグワイルドカード進出への勢いをくじいた。
articles.body:
CHICAGO -- — Griffin Conine drove in Esteury Ruiz with a tiebreaking single in Miami's six-run 12th inning, and the Marlins stymied Chicago's push for an NL wild card with an 8-2 victory over the Cubs on Tuesday night.


              Conine put Miami ahead to stay with his well-placed blooper to left field. Jakob Marsee added a run-scoring single, and Joe Mack capped the outburst with a two-run single.


              Kyle Stowers hit a solo homer for the Marlins (77-80), who had lost three in a row. Josh Ekness (3-4) pitched a scoreless inning for the win.


              The Cubs (87-70) could have clinched a playoff berth with a win or an Arizona loss, but the Diamondbacks won 7-2 at Colorado.


              Chicago and San Diego were tied at the top of the wild-card standings going into Tuesday’s action, and Philadelphia was one game back in the third slot. The Phillies posted a 6-4 victory over Milwaukee, and the Padres were at the Los Angeles Dodgers later Tuesday night.


              The Cubs had a chance to win the game in the 10th, loading the bases with two down. But Miami second baseman Javier Sanoja robbed Pedro Ramírez of a game-ending single with a terrific sliding stop.


              Chicago played without third baseman Alex Bregman, who is recovering from multiple facial fractures after he was struck in the face by a foul ball. The three-time All-Star could return to the lineup before the end of the regular season this weekend. 


              Miami jumped in front when Stowers doubled and scored on Agustín Ramírez's single in the fourth. Stowers added his 20th homer in the sixth.


              Chicago rallied in the bottom half, putting runners on the corners with no outs. Michael Busch then hit a hard grounder to first, but Mack mishandled Deyvison De Los Santos' throw to the plate and Pete Crow-Armstrong scampered home with the Cubs' first run. One batter later, Ian Happ hit a tying single off Calvin Faucher.


              Up next
              Ryan Gusto (1-5, 4.14 ERA) starts for Miami on Wednesday night, and fellow right-hander Kevin Gausman (9-12, 4.55) pitches for Chicago. 


              ------

articles.headline: Clippers name Trent Redden interim president of basketball ops
articles.description: The LA Clippers named general manager Trent Redden as the team's interim president of basketball operations while Lawrence Frank serves his six-month suspension.
articles.headlineJa: クリッパーズ、トレント・レデンをバスケットボール部門の暫定代表に任命
articles.descriptionJa: ロサンゼルス・クリッパーズは、ローレンス・フランクが6か月間の停職処分を受ける中、ゼネラルマネージャーのトレント・レデンをチームのバスケットボール部門暫定代表に任命した。
articles.body:
The LA Clippers named general manager Trent Redden as the team's interim president of basketball operations while Lawrence Frank serves his six-month suspension stemming from the NBA's investigation into salary cap circumvention.

The announcement was made via a video message from interim team governor and CEO John Gibson to fans. Gibson, who is serving as interim governor while Steve Ballmer serves his one-year suspension, also announced that assistant general manager Mark Hughes will take over GM duties in the meantime.

 

Redden joined the Clippers' front office in 2017 after a long run with the Cleveland Cavaliers. He was promoted from assistant general manager to GM in 2023. Hughes also came to the Clippers in 2017 after several years as an assistant coach in the NBA after his pro playing career.

The suspensions of Ballmer and Frank came down after a yearlong investigation into the Clippers by law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. Along with Ballmer's suspension, the NBA issued a $30 million fine and the forfeiture of five first-round draft picks.

Ballmer recently accepted the NBA's punishment, saying in a statement, in part, that though there are still disagreements with the findings, "We are complying with the penalties assessed by the league, have paid the fine and are moving forward."

articles.headline: Diamondbacks beat Rockies 7-2, send Colorado to its 4th straight season of 100 or more losses
articles.description: — Nolan Arenado had his team-leading 28th homer of the season among his three hits, Michael Soroka struck out nine in seven innings of one-run ball and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat Colorado 7-2 Tuesday night, sending the Rockies to their 100th loss...
articles.headlineJa: ダイヤモンドバックスがロッキーズを7-2で破り、コロラドを4年連続の100敗以上に追いやる
articles.descriptionJa: 火曜夜、ノーラン・アレナドがチームトップとなる今季28号本塁打を含む3安打を放ち、マイケル・ソロカが7回1失点9脱三振の好投を見せ、アリゾナ・ダイヤモンドバックスがコロラドに7-2で勝利。ロッキーズに今季100敗目を突きつけた...
articles.body:
DENVER -- — Nolan Arenado had his team-leading 28th homer of the season among his three hits, Michael Soroka struck out nine in seven innings of one-run ball and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat Colorado 7-2 Tuesday night, sending the Rockies to their 100th loss of the season.


              The victory kept the Diamondbacks four games behind Philadelphia in the race for the third and final NL wild-card spot with five regular-season games remaining for both teams.


              The Rockies’ loss made Colorado the first franchise to lose at least 100 games in four consecutive seasons since the New York Mets from 1962-65.


              Arenado, a four-time All-Star in his time with Colorado, extended his on-base streak to 16 games. During that stretch, he is batting .379 with seven homers and 14 RBI.


              Gabriel Moreno drove in two runs, giving him 10 RBI in Arizona’s past 16 games. Geraldo Perdomo added three hits and an RBI for the Diamondbacks.


              In four starts against the Rockies this season, Soroka (9-5) has allowed just four earned runs in 23 innings, with 23 strikeouts and six walks.


              Kyle Freeland (4-11) took the loss for Colorado, allowing five earned runs in three innings. The Denver native made his final home start of the season for Colorado, where he has played his entire 10-year MLB career.


              Mickey Moniak and Connor Norby drove in Colorado's runs. Moniak hit his 23rd home run of the season. TJ Rumfield and Jake McCarthy failed to record a hit or walk. The two entered the game with the longest active on-base streaks in the majors, with Rumfield at 24 games and McCarthy at 22.


              Up next
              Arizona RHP Merrill Kelly (9-14, 5.00 ERA) will take on Colorado RHP Mason Adams (0-1, 5.09) on Wednesday in the second game of a three-game series.


              ------

articles.headline: Woman says she reported alleged 49ers impersonator to team in December
articles.description: A woman who says she is a victim in the FBI's fraud case against Daejon Love said she sent a "complaint/concern" to the Niners in December 2025, eight months before Love was arrested and charged with wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud.
articles.headlineJa: 49ers関係者を装ったとされる人物について、女性が12月にチームに通報したと語る
articles.descriptionJa: デイジョン・ラブに対するFBIの詐欺事件の被害者であると主張する女性は、ラブが電信詐欺および電信詐欺の共謀罪で逮捕・起訴される8か月前の2025年12月に、49ersに「苦情・懸念」を送ったと述べた。
articles.body:
A woman who says she is a victim in the FBI's fraud case against Daejon Love, a man who is accused of impersonating a San Francisco 49ers player, told ESPN on Tuesday that she submitted a complaint about him via the team's website in December, eight months before he was arrested.

Gwen Herndon said she sent a "complaint/concern" form submission to the Niners on Dec. 20, 2025. According to her message, which was reviewed by ESPN, Herndon wrote that "there is a federal investigation surrounding a man pretending to be a 49ers player," naming Love, and saying he stole money from women and that "he is severely damaging the reputation of your team."

"I wanted you to be aware of the situation and hopefully proactive in denouncing his involvement on your team," she wrote in the message.

In the email exchange provided by Herndon, she received a response from a general Levi's Stadium guest services account a week later on Dec. 27, 2025.

"We take reports of individuals misrepresenting themselves as members of the San Francisco 49ers very seriously," the response said. "For safety and legal reasons, the team cannot comment on ongoing investigations or specific individuals. However, we appreciate you bringing this to our attention and encouraging proactive measures to protect the integrity of the organization.

"If you have information that could assist law enforcement or legal authorities, we encourage you to contact the appropriate agencies directly. Our internal team will also monitor any instances of impersonation and take action as appropriate to protect fans and the team's reputation. Thank you again for your vigilance and concern for the Niners community," the email said.

Herndon said she had no further contact with the 49ers after the email response in December. It's unclear whether anyone at the Niners reviewed the email Herndon said she sent. A Niners team source told ESPN last week that the team had not received any reports about Love before it was contacted by the FBI in August.

On Tuesday, a 49ers spokesperson declined to confirm the email's existence or to provide further comment on the email, citing the FBI's ongoing investigation.

Love and his alleged partner in the scheme, Taylor Chan, were arrested Aug. 24 and charged with wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud. Federal authorities said the duo defrauded more than two dozen women out of about $1.3 million.

Love would meet women via dating apps, falsely portray himself as a "legitimately wealthy" 49ers player or real estate investor and solicit money from them, the FBI said. According to federal court filings, Love was wearing 49ers apparel when he was arrested in Boise, Idaho, and "the FBI later learned from interviews that Love was in Boise as part of his scheme and was actively defrauding three more victims in Idaho."

articles.headline: Rest-of-season rankings: Walker, Shough on the rise while Maye, McConkey fall
articles.description: Need a quick free agent pickup -- or roster overhaul -- after Week 2? These rankings are designed to help.
articles.headlineJa: 残りシーズンのランキング：ウォーカーとショウが上昇、メイとマコンキーは下落
articles.descriptionJa: 第2週を終えてフリーエージェントの補強やロースターの刷新が必要ですか？このランキングがその手助けとなります。
articles.body:
Each week, Eric Karabell ranks players by position based on their fantasy football value for the rest of the 2026 season. Use the information to optimize the players for their future potential and/or to gauge their value in trade. Eric's top 100 can be found below the positions in this column. 

Quarterback

Rankings changes: Wow. Serious injuries to the top two selections from the 2024 draft and a late 2025 first-rounder are the story, as fantasy managers will miss the Bears' Caleb Williams (hamstring), Commanders' Jayden Daniels (elbow) and Giants' Jaxson Dart (knee) for an undetermined length of time. Each was among our top 10 QBs. Perhaps the mercurial Williams will return far sooner, so he remains in QB2 range in these rankings, but the risk of reinjury is high. Dart might be lost for the season. Backups Jameis Winston and Marcus Mariota enter the rankings, and they might be playing for months.

With three passers dropping in the rankings, nearly everyone else rises. The 49ers' Brock Purdy, Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes, Saints' Tyler Shough and Lions' Jared Goff are all in the top 10. The Panthers' Bryce Young rises into safer QB2 territory, with room for more. The Patriots' Drake Maye, last year's No. 2 QB scorer, remains in the top 10, but perhaps not for long after two disappointing outings totaling 17.84 points. The Rams' Matthew Stafford rebounds from Australia and is No. 11. It is quite amazing how quickly fantasy value changes in the NFL.

Running back

Rankings changes: Volume is king, and no running back earned more in Week 2 than the Chiefs' Kenneth Walker III. Will he stay healthy? That was an offseason concern, but so far he looks awesome and he continues rising into the top 10. For those who want Walker at No. 1 ... c'mon, we are not there yet. Walker versus Bijan Robinson? It feels premature, though Robinson does drop a spot behind Jonathan Taylor to No. 3. Praise Walker, but if a Robinson investor offers him for Walker, do it.

Broncos rookie Jonah Coleman is among the big risers at running back, though we lack confirmation of solid volume moving ahead (same with the Patriots' TreVeyon Henderson). The Buccaneers' Bucky Irving and Panthers' Chuba Hubbard rise to RB2 status, as their reported timeshares appear to be rather one-sided. Aaron Jones Sr. is healthy and seeing volume. Don't forget about the Saints' Alvin Kamara and Seahawks' Zach Charbonnet, and watch for injury updates on the Eagles' Saquon Barkley.

Wide receiver

Rankings changes: Many star receivers delivered in Week 2, but the rankings movement at this position happened in the late WR2 range, as the Panthers' Jalen Coker, Packers' Christian Watson, Broncos' Jaylen Waddle, Jaguars' Parker Washington and Browns' Denzel Boston continue to add value. Perhaps they catch some early underachievers such as the Falcons' Drake London and Cowboys' George Pickens soon. They have already passed the Chargers' Ladd McConkey and Lions' Jameson Williams.

articles.headline: 2026 NBA offseason trade grades: Finney-Smith, Schroder, more deals
articles.description: We're grading the biggest NBA trades of the offseason, including the Atlanta deal that sent Hield and Nembhard to Charlotte for Finney-Smith.
articles.headlineJa: 2026年NBAオフシーズン トレード評価：フィニー・スミス、シュルーダー、その他の取引
articles.descriptionJa: ヒールドとネムハードがフィニー・スミスとの交換でシャーロットへ移籍したアトランタの取引をはじめ、オフシーズンにおけるNBAの主なトレードを採点する。
articles.body:
The NBA offseason is here, with Aaron Wiggins' trade to the Atlanta Hawks on June 22 the first move in what has already been a frenzied offseason.

The big news came a day before the NBA draft, when Giannis Antetokounmpo was traded by the Milwaukee Bucks to the Miami Heat in a blockbuster. There was another big trade the morning after the draft, as the Charlotte Hornets shipped LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves. And the trades haven't stopped since.

I'm grading every trade this offseason, including draft deals, and breaking down the ramifications for all teams and players involved.

To determine each grade, I'm looking at multiple factors, including the on-court impact and ages of involved players, the cost in terms of draft picks and future financial implications, and the context of the team's short- and long-term outlooks. How risky or certain is the move? And how much does it help or hurt the team's chance to win the championship, next season or beyond?

Let's get into the latest moves:

Quick links: 

Latest buzz | FA signing grades | Trade machine

Depth charts | Offseason guides | Draft coverage

Sept. 22: Hawks send Hield, Nembhard to Hornets for Finney-Smith

Charlotte Hornets get: G Buddy Hield, G Ryan Nembhard, cash considerations

Atlanta Hawks get: F Dorian Finney-Smith

Grade for Hawks: B+

For the Hawks, this swap of reserve wings is primarily about resolving a roster crunch, as they trade two players -- including backup guard Nembhard, whom they had initially acquired alongside Luguentz Dort in an earlier trade -- for one.

That fix comes at a minor price, as Finney-Smith will earn $14.2 million this season, compared with $11.8 million combined for Hield and Nembhard. (Finney-Smith and Hield are both nominally signed for additional years, but for zero guaranteed money.) The Hawks are reportedly sending cash to Charlotte in this deal, as well.

But this deal is smart business for the Hawks because it gives them another potential two-way contributor on the wing, as they build out a fearsome defensive rotation. Hield doesn't fit that mold, and he never seemed to find his footing in Atlanta. He arrived from Golden State in the Kristaps Porzingis trade last February but played just 51 minutes over the rest of the regular season, as the Hawks enjoyed their late-season surge without him.

Finney-Smith, meanwhile, was far worse than Hield last season, as he averaged only 3.3 points per game and made 27% of his 3s after returning from ankle surgery. That disappointing level of production incentivized Houston to trade him to Charlotte earlier this offseason, in a salary dump that brought the Hornets three second-round picks.

But as I wrote at the time of that initial trade, "Finney-Smith failed to launch in Houston, but he was a standout role player as recently as the 2024-25 season, due to his 3-and-D skill set and excellent on/off rating. articles.description: Former Liverpool defender Andy Robertson has said that the death of teammate Diogo Jota was "horrendous" and had a major impact on the players that knew him.
articles.headlineJa: アンディ・ロバートソン、ディオゴ・ジョタの死後のリヴァプールについて語る：「サッカーのことなど頭になかった」
articles.descriptionJa: 元リヴァプールのDFアンディ・ロバートソンは、チームメイトであったディオゴ・ジョタの死は「恐ろしいこと」であり、彼を知る選手たちに甚大な影響を与えたと語った。

articles.headline: Estêvão on reduced game time at Chelsea: 'I try to seize every opportunity I have'
articles.description: Estêvão says he is focused only on what he can control after struggling for game time at Chelsea under new manager Xabi Alonso.
articles.headlineJa: チェルシーでの出場時間減少についてエステヴァン：「与えられたすべての機会を活かそうとしている」
articles.descriptionJa: エステヴァンは、シャビ・アロンソ新監督の下でチェルシーでの出場時間確保に苦心する中、自分でコントロールできることだけに集中していると語った。

articles.headline: Real Madrid conspiracy claims dismissed as a 'smokescreen' by LaLiga president
articles.description: LaLiga president Javier Tebas has called claims of a refereeing conspiracy against Real Madrid "a smokescreen to hide other shortcomings" after the team's defeat to Atletico Madrid in Sunday's derby.
articles.headlineJa: レアル・マドリードの陰謀論主張をラ・リーガ会長が「隠れみの」と一蹴
articles.descriptionJa: ラ・リーガのハビエル・テバス会長は、日曜日のダービーでアトレティコ・マドリードに敗れたレアル・マドリード側の「審判の陰謀論」の主張に対し、「他の欠点を隠すための隠れみの」と断じた。

articles.headline: Benjamin Šeško vows to 'fully dedicate' himself to recovery after Man United injury setback
articles.description: Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko has vowed to "fully dedicate" himself to his recovery from an ongoing shin issue.
articles.headlineJa: マンUで怪我に見舞われたベンヤミン・シェシュコ、回復に「全力を尽くす」と誓う
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのストライカー、ベンヤミン・シェシュコは、続いているすねの傷みの回復に「全力を尽くす」と誓った。

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé on past Liverpool transfer talks: 'Mum went to Anfield and fell in love'
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé has described how his mother "fell in love" with Anfield and was keen for him to sign for Liverpool before he decided to join PSG.
articles.headlineJa: キリアン・エムバペが過去のリヴァプール移籍交渉を回想：「母がアンフィールドに行って惚れ込んだ」
articles.descriptionJa: キリアン・エムバペは、PSG加入を決める前に母親がアンフィールドに「惚れ込み」、リヴァプールへの移籍を強く望んでいた経緯を明かした。

articles.headline: Man United-linked Lewis Hall: 'No-brainer' to stay at Newcastle
articles.description: Lewis Hall has said it was a "no-brainer" to sign a new contract to extend his Newcastle United stay after summer transfer interest from Manchester United.
articles.headlineJa: マンU関心のルイス・ホール、ニューカッスル残留は「迷う余地もなかった」
articles.descriptionJa: ルイス・ホールは、夏の移籍市場でマンチェスター・ユナイテッドからの関心が寄せられたものの、新契約を結んでニューカッスル・ユナイテッドでの滞在を延長することは「迷う余地もない選択」だったと語りました。
